note: Adjudicated accidental variants (punctuation). Substantive text agrees across all three witnesses with zero variants.

adjudicated.ruling: No stop after Amen, with the approved Benziger printing (p. 220): its line Sacerdos dicit: Amen et erigit se runs the priest's Amen straight into the rubric. Witnesses do and handmissal-eo close the Amen with a full stop, and the separately set Vatican printing of the 1962 Missal sets a comma after it.
